| RQ-C11-11697 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Attenuation invariant: `limited` must never read: parent scope outside its subtree. | 0831 §603.318 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11698 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Function requirements: Example: @requires(NetworkConnect) fn download(...) Compiler records requirement. | 0831 §603.319 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11699 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Capability injection: Application entrypoint may receive: fn main(args, caps: AppCapabilities) where `AppCapabilities` is generated from deployment manifest. | 0831 §603.320 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11700 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Generated capability object: Compiler/toolchain may generate: AppCapabilities.files AppCapabilities.network AppCapabilities.process only for requested capabilities. | 0831 §603.321 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11701 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — No unused authority: If application never requests: ProcessSpawn generated `AppCapabilities.process` should not exist. | 0831 §603.322 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11702 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Capability discoverability: Developer tooling can inspect generated capability set. | 0831 §603.323 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11703 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Security boundary API: Minimal: security.check(...) security.require(...) security.request(...) security.drop(...) security.status(...) | 0831 §603.324 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11704 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — `require`: `require(capability)` must fail deterministically if absent. | 0831 §603.325 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11705 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — `check`: `check` is non-throwing/preflight. | 0831 §603.326 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11706 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — `request`: May interact with platform permission mechanism. | 0831 §603.327 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11707 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — `drop`: Irreversibly attenuates current context. | 0831 §603.328 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11708 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Security scope: security.scope(limited_caps) { ... } restores previous context after scope. | 0831 §603.329 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11709 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Scope safety: Scope restoration must occur even if error/panic propagation occurs where runtime supports structured unwinding. | 0831 §603.330 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11710 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Async scope: Capability scope must propagate according to explicit task semantics. | 0831 §603.331 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11711 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Capability context inheritance: Default: child task receives parent's non-sensitive capabilities Sensitive/high privilege capabilities require explicit delegation. | 0831 §603.332 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11712 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — High-risk capability class: High-risk capabilities: ProcessDebug RawDevice RawSocket ExecutableMemory SystemConfig CredentialAccess must not automatically propagate. | 0831 §603.333 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11713 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Capability classification: Capabilities can have risk metadata: normal sensitive privileged system This is descriptive metadata, not a generic security score. | 0831 §603.334 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11714 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Capability policy: High-risk capabilities require stronger deployment approval. | 0831 §603.335 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11715 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Security UI: Runtime itself remains UI-neutral. Platform shell may display permission prompts. | 0831 §603.336 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11716 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — User denial: User denial returns normal `SecurityError`. No repeated prompt loop. | 0831 §603.337 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11717 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Permission persistence: Persistence semantics delegated to OS/deployment. | 0831 §603.338 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11718 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Mobile lifecycle: When application backgrounded/suspended, capabilities may become temporarily unusable. Operations must handle OS denial. | 0831 §603.339 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11719 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Capability status: Status can be: active temporarily_unavailable revoked denied | 0831 §603.340 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11720 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — WASM host capability: Host provides explicit imports. Axiom runtime cannot access host resources not imported. | 0831 §603.341 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11721 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — WASM sandbox invariant: WASM linear memory does not imply host filesystem/network authority. | 0831 §603.342 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11722 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Native sandbox: Native sandbox policy must be queried at startup. | 0831 §603.343 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11723 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Security bootstrap report: Startup diagnostics can record: security profile sandbox type policy fingerprint granted capability count | 0831 §603.344 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11724 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — No capability value logging: Never output actual capability token internals. | 0831 §603.345 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11725 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Capability leak prevention: Capability objects should not implement generic string serialization. | 0831 §603.346 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11726 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Generic serialization restriction: Compiler rejects serialization of capability types unless explicit safe projection exists. | 0831 §603.347 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11727 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Equality semantics: Capability equality means: same authority/resource identity not token byte equality exposed to application. | 0831 §603.348 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11728 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Hash semantics: Capability can be hashable only through stable opaque identity. | 0831 §603.349 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11729 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Ordering: Capabilities do not have meaningful ordering. | 0831 §603.350 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11730 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Capability type system: Each capability kind is distinct at compile time. | 0831 §603.351 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11731 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Generic capability constraints: Functions may accept: fn read<T: ReadCapability>(cap: T) if useful. | 0831 §603.352 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11732 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Capability traits: Traits can describe: Readable Writable Connectable Delegatable Revocable | 0831 §603.353 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11733 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Trait semantics: Capability trait does not grant authority. It describes operations supported by an already-authorized capability. | 0831 §603.354 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11734 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Struct-only integration: Capability objects are ordinary Axiom structs with runtime-managed opaque handles. No class hierarchy required. | 0831 §603.355 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11735 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Method integration: Methods: fn read(self: FileRead, ...) follow Axiom struct-first method convention. | 0831 §603.356 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11736 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Override integration: Platform-specific capability implementations can override behavior through trait/function dispatch without requiring classes. | 0831 §603.357 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11737 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Dynamic dispatch: Security-critical dispatch must not rely on mutable user-controlled vtables. | 0831 §603.358 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11738 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Static dispatch preference: Compile-time known capability operations should prefer static dispatch. | 0831 §603.359 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11739 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Security metadata and generics: Generic functions must preserve capability requirements after monomorphization/specialization. | 0831 §603.360 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11740 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Capability requirements in IR: Compiler IR includes: requires_capability acquire_capability attenuate_capability release_capability where needed. | 0831 §603.361 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11741 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — IR validation: IR verifier must reject invalid capability operations: forge upgrade use-after-drop wrong-kind | 0831 §603.362 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11742 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Linker security verification: Linker validates final capability metadata against object/module metadata. | 0831 §603.363 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11743 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Loader verification: Native loader/runtime verifies signed/trusted module metadata before granting privileged capabilities where configured. | 0831 §603.364 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11744 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Runtime module quarantine: Untrusted dynamic module may load into isolated process instead of same process. | 0831 §603.365 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11745 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Security policy compiler output: Compact policy: .cap or equivalent. Exact extension remains implementation detail. | 0831 §603.366 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11746 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Policy format version: Security policy format must be versioned independently from application config. | 0831 §603.367 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11747 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Policy parser security: Parser must be: bounded non-executable deterministic | 0831 §603.368 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11748 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — No policy scripting: Core security policy must not execute arbitrary user scripts. | 0831 §603.369 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11749 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Policy expressions: Keep policy language declarative: allow capability X scope resource Y deny operation Z | 0831 §603.370 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11750 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — No arbitrary code in policy: Policy evaluation cannot call application functions. | 0831 §603.371 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11751 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Policy complexity: Avoid general-purpose rule engines in runtime. | 0831 §603.372 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11752 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Fast path: Common decision: capability handle valid + resource within scope + operation allowed → direct allow. | 0831 §603.373 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11753 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Slow path: Only complex cases use policy engine. | 0831 §603.374 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11754 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Security startup cost: Startup policy compilation should be O(policy size). | 0831 §603.375 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11755 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Runtime check complexity: Common resource checks should be O(1) or bounded. | 0831 §603.376 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11756 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Memory footprint: Security runtime should use: immutable policy snapshot capability table small generation state rather than heavyweight object graphs. | 0831 §603.377 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11757 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — No GC dependency: Security subsystem must not require garbage collection. | 0831 §603.378 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11758 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Memory safety: Capability implementation must obey Axiom memory model and cannot depend on GC or borrow checker. | 0831 §603.379 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11759 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Handle safety: Generation/index validation provides use-after-free protection for runtime-managed capability handles. | 0831 §603.380 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11760 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Integer overflow: Capability/resource calculations must use checked arithmetic where overflow can affect security. | 0831 §603.381 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11761 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Canonical resource IDs: Resources should use canonical identifiers to avoid alternate-path authorization bypasses. | 0831 §603.382 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11762 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — File case sensitivity: Path security adapter must respect platform case semantics. | 0831 §603.383 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11763 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Unicode normalization: Filesystem/network identifiers requiring canonicalization must define Unicode normalization policy per platform. | 0831 §603.384 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11764 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Homograph handling: Security policy should avoid relying on human-readable names as identity. | 0831 §603.385 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11765 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — DNS security: Network authorization should account for DNS resolution changes if policy is hostname-based. | 0831 §603.386 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11766 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Hostname capability semantics: If capability says: api.example.com implementation must define whether authority follows: hostname resolved IP both | 0831 §603.387 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11767 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — TLS: TLS authentication belongs to network/security libraries, while capability controls network authority. | 0831 §603.388 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11768 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Certificate authority: Certificate trust configuration is separate from capability grant. | 0831 §603.389 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11769 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Network identity distinction: NetworkConnect does not imply: trusted server | 0831 §603.390 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11770 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — File identity distinction: FileRead does not imply: file contents are trusted | 0831 §603.391 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11771 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Device identity distinction: DeviceAccess does not imply device data is safe. | 0831 §603.392 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11772 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Trust boundary input validation: Capability grants access; parser validation still required. | 0831 §603.393 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11773 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Security architecture invariant: authority != trustworthiness of data | 0831 §603.394 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11774 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Security and diagnostics: BOOTSTRAP-602 records security decisions. BOOTSTRAP-603 decides authorization. | 0831 §603.395 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11775 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Security and config: BOOTSTRAP-601 provides policy inputs. BOOTSTRAP-603 validates/executes them. | 0831 §603.396 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11776 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Security and state: BOOTSTRAP-600 persists application state, never live privilege state. | 0831 §603.397 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11777 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Security and compiler: Compiler proves/records declared authority requirements. Runtime enforces actual authority. | 0831 §603.398 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11778 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Security and OS: OS remains final authority for kernel-protected resources. Axiom cannot grant more than OS allows. | 0831 §603.399 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11779 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Security core invariant: The complete authority chain is: OS authority ↓ deployment policy ↓ Axiom security policy ↓ capability ↓ operation A lower layer cannot increase authority beyond the upper boundary. | 0831 §603.400 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11780 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Required implementation phases: ### Phase 1 — Capability primitives Capability<T> generation opaque handle attenuation drop ### Phase 2 — Filesystem/network FileRead FileWrite NetworkConnect NetworkListen ### Phase 3 — Process/IPC ProcessSpawn ProcessDebug IPC SharedMemory ### Phase 4 — Compiler integration @requires capability metadata IR validation linker merge ### Phase 5 — Platform integration Windows Linux macOS iOS Android WASM ### Phase 6 — Sandboxing/trust plugin isolation module trust signature verification policy enforcement ### Phase 7 — Advanced security revocation quotas audit policy reload security tooling | 0831 §603.401 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11781 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Required tests: At minimum: capability forgery wrong capability type stale handle revoked handle attenuation escape path traversal symlink escape network scope violation process privilege violation IPC unauthorized request plugin overreach FFI boundary policy reload policy corruption secret leakage concurrent revoke/use | 0831 §603.402 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11782 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Cross-platform acceptance: Required targets: Windows x64 Linux x64 Linux ARM64 macOS ARM64 iOS ARM64 Android ARM64 WASM Unsupported platform capability must return: NotSupported not silently grant access. | 0831 §603.403 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11783 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Performance acceptance: Common authorized operation must not require: string permission lookup global mutex dynamic policy parsing on every call. | 0831 §603.404 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11784 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Binary-size acceptance: Applications that do not use advanced security capabilities should not pull: policy compiler plugin verifier signature subsystem advanced audit into the final binary unnecessarily. | 0831 §603.405 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11785 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Security acceptance: Must prove: no capability forgery no authority escalation through attenuation no stale capability reuse no policy-cache bypass no partial policy reload no secret serialization no silent fail-open | 0831 §603.406 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11786 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Developer experience acceptance: Simple application: fn main(caps: AppCapabilities) { let file = caps.data.read("hello.txt") print(file) } should not require developers to understand the complete security engine. | 0831 §603.407 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11787 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Advanced developer experience: Security-sensitive server: fn run(caps: ServerCapabilities) { let listener = caps.network.listen(443) spawn(worker, with = [ caps.data.read_only() ]) } should make authority explicit and easy to audit. | 0831 §603.408 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11788 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Final architectural principle: Axiom security should follow: > **Explicit authority, least privilege, monotonic attenuation, fail-closed enforcement, platform-native isolation, and negligible overhead when unused.** | 0831 §603.409 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11789 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — BOOTSTRAP-603 completion invariant: BOOTSTRAP-603 is complete at architecture level when: capability model + permission model + policy engine + resource scoping + privilege separation + sandbox integration + IPC security + module/plugin trust + secret integration + compiler metadata + IR enforcement + linker validation + runtime enforcement + OS adapters + audit integration + revocation + resource limits + security testing đã được định nghĩa đủ để triển khai compiler/runtime mà không cần thiết kế lại security foundation. | 0831 §603.410 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11790 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Mục tiêu: Axiom cần một IPC runtime thống nhất để các process có thể: - gửi message; - gọi request/response; - truyền stream; - truyền buffer lớn; - chia sẻ memory; - truyền OS handle; - truyền capability; - phát event; - phát hiện peer chết; - timeout/cancel; - reconnect; - kiểm soát backpressure; - xác thực peer; - kiểm soát quyền truy cập. IPC phải hoạt động trên: - Windows; - Linux; - macOS; - Android; - iOS; - WASM/WASI ở mức capability phù hợp; - embedded target nếu platform adapter cung cấp primitive tương ứng. IPC core **không được phụ thuộc vào TCP/IP**. IPC mạng và distributed networking là lớp khác. | 0832 §604.0 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11791 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Nguyên tắc kiến trúc: Axiom IPC được chia thành các lớp: Application ↓ Service / RPC API ↓ Message API ↓ Transport ↓ OS IPC Primitive Shared memory đi theo nhánh: Application ↓ SharedBuffer / SharedRegion ↓ SharedMemory Transport ↓ OS Shared Memory Primitive Security: BOOTSTRAP-603 ↓ Capability ↓ Endpoint authorization ↓ Message / shared-memory operation Diagnostics: BOOTSTRAP-602 ↓ IPC trace / metrics / faults State: BOOTSTRAP-600 ↓ checkpoint / recovery integration Configuration: BOOTSTRAP-601 ↓ endpoint / limits / policy configuration | 0832 §604.1 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11792 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — IPC không phải distributed system: Core IPC chỉ đảm bảo semantics trong phạm vi mà transport hỗ trợ. Axiom không tuyên bố: - exactly-once delivery; - distributed transactions; - consensus; - distributed locks; - global ordering; - network reliability. Những chức năng đó thuộc distributed/runtime service layer. Đặc biệt: IPC ≠ networking IPC ≠ distributed computing IPC ≠ message broker IPC có thể sử dụng socket transport nhưng socket chỉ là implementation detail. | 0832 §604.2 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11793 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Các primitive chính: Core IPC cung cấp: Endpoint Channel Message Request Response Stream Event SharedRegion SharedBuffer Handle Peer Service Subscription Các primitive này phải có ABI ổn định. | 0832 §604.3 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11794 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Endpoint: Endpoint xác định một điểm giao tiếp. Khái niệm: Endpoint scheme name namespace security transport Ví dụ: ipc://app/service ipc://user/cache ipc://system/logger Không expose trực tiếp OS-specific naming vào application API. | 0832 §604.4 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11795 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Endpoint namespace: Có ba namespace: ProcessLocal User System Ví dụ: ipc://process/foo ipc://user/myapp/cache ipc://system/service Application không được tự ý tạo endpoint thuộc namespace cao hơn capability được cấp. | 0832 §604.5 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11796 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Endpoint identity: Endpoint identity gồm: EndpointId ServiceName InstanceId Namespace Generation `Generation` giúp tránh nhầm endpoint cũ sau khi service restart. | 0832 §604.6 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11797 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Service: Service là logical owner của một hoặc nhiều endpoint. Ví dụ: service ImageProcessor { fn resize(image: Image, width: u32, height: u32) -> Image } Compiler có thể sinh: ImageProcessorClient ImageProcessorServer ImageProcessorMessage ImageProcessorCodec | 0832 §604.7 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11798 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Struct-only service model: Axiom không cần class để xây service. Ví dụ: struct ImageProcessor { workers: u32 } fn process(self: ImageProcessor, image: Image) -> Result<Image> IPC binding chỉ coi function có metadata service là RPC method. @ipc fn process(self: ImageProcessor, image: Image) -> Result<Image> `self` không phải object reference đặc biệt. Nó vẫn là tham số struct bình thường. | 0832 §604.8 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11799 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Method identity: Mỗi IPC method có: ServiceId MethodId SchemaVersion Không sử dụng tên string làm identifier runtime chính. Compiler tạo ID ổn định từ declaration metadata. Có thể cho phép explicit ID: @ipc(id=0x1020) fn process(...) | 0832 §604.9 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11800 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Channel: Channel là đường truyền hai chiều logic: Peer A ←→ Channel ←→ Peer B Channel có: send() recv() close() cancel() Channel không nhất thiết tương ứng 1:1 với OS socket/pipe. | 0832 §604.10 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11801 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — One-way channel: Cho event/fire-and-forget: channel.send(event) Không tạo response queue nếu không cần. Điều này giảm: - memory; - context switching; - bookkeeping. | 0832 §604.11 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11802 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Request/response: RPC semantics: request → response Mỗi request có: RequestId MethodId Payload Deadline Flags Response: RequestId Status Payload Flags | 0832 §604.12 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11803 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Request ID: `RequestId` là 128-bit logical identifier hoặc dạng compact 64-bit trong fast path. Runtime phải chống collision trong phạm vi channel. | 0832 §604.13 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11804 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Streaming: Một request có thể trả nhiều chunk: request ↓ chunk ↓ chunk ↓ chunk ↓ complete Không cần gom toàn bộ stream vào RAM. API: stream.next() stream.cancel() | 0832 §604.14 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11805 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Event subscription: Service có thể phát event: @event struct FrameReady { frame: Frame } Client: subscribe(FrameReady) Subscription phải có lifecycle rõ ràng. | 0832 §604.15 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11806 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Message envelope: Mọi message transport-level có envelope: magic version flags message_type schema_id request_id payload_size header_size payload Envelope phải được thiết kế để: - parse nhanh; - validate nhanh; - forward-compatible; - chống malformed input. | 0832 §604.16 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11807 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Message size: Không có message size vô hạn. Mỗi endpoint có: max_message_size max_queue_bytes max_inflight_requests Giá trị mặc định phải bounded. Application có thể tăng thông qua capability/configuration phù hợp. | 0832 §604.17 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11808 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Serialization: Axiom IPC serialization sử dụng binary encoding mặc định. Không dùng: - JSON; - XML; - reflection runtime nặng; cho fast-path native IPC. Text encoding chỉ là adapter. | 0832 §604.18 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11809 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — ABI-safe serialization: Không serialize raw memory layout của struct mặc định. Sai: send(raw_bytes_of_struct) Đúng: logical field encoding Điều này tránh phụ thuộc: - padding; - alignment; - pointer size; - compiler version; - endian; - target ABI. | 0832 §604.19 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11810 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Primitive encoding: Các primitive có canonical representation: u8/u16/u32/u64 i8/i16/i32/i64 f32/f64 bool char bytes string array map optional enum struct UTF-8 là encoding mặc định cho string. | 0832 §604.20 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11811 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Integer encoding: Mặc định: fixed-width cho predictable decoding. Varint chỉ dùng khi schema đánh dấu: @compact Compiler không được tự ý thay đổi wire representation mà phá compatibility. | 0832 §604.21 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11812 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Endianness: Wire format sử dụng một endian canonical. Native endian chỉ được dùng trong shared-memory structures khi region có ABI descriptor tương ứng. | 0832 §604.22 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11813 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Schema identity: Mỗi schema có: SchemaId Version Fingerprint Fingerprint được compiler tạo deterministic. Ví dụ: SchemaId = hash(canonical_schema_definition) | 0832 §604.23 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11814 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Schema evolution: Cho phép: - thêm field; - bỏ field; - field optional; - enum extension; - version negotiation. Không cho phép silently thay đổi meaning của field cũ. | 0832 §604.24 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11815 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Unknown fields: Decoder phải có khả năng: ignore unknown field khi schema cho phép. Điều này giúp rolling upgrade. | 0832 §604.25 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11816 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Required field: Core schema nên hạn chế required fields để giảm compatibility problem. Field quan trọng có thể: field: T Field backward-compatible: field?: T | 0832 §604.26 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11817 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Bounds validation: Decoder phải validate trước khi cấp phát. Không được: read count allocate count * element_size mà không kiểm tra overflow/bounds. Phải: validate count validate byte_size validate remaining payload then allocate | 0832 §604.27 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11818 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Zero-copy: IPC runtime phải hỗ trợ ba path: Copy Move ZeroCopy Runtime tự chọn path dựa trên transport và message type. | 0832 §604.28 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11819 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Small message fast path: Message nhỏ nên được truyền trực tiếp qua inline buffer. Ví dụ: ≤ 256 bytes có thể sử dụng inline storage tùy backend. Mục tiêu: - không heap allocation; - ít syscall; - ít copy. | 0832 §604.29 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11820 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Large message path: Message lớn chuyển sang: SharedRegion thay vì copy nhiều lần. Pattern: control message ↓ shared memory handle ↓ large payload | 0832 §604.30 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11821 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — SharedRegion: `SharedRegion` biểu diễn vùng memory có thể map vào nhiều process. Properties: RegionId size protection owner generation capability | 0832 §604.31 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11822 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — SharedBuffer: `SharedBuffer` là slice có bounds: region offset length Không chứa raw pointer cross-process. | 0832 §604.32 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11823 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Cross-process pointer prohibition: Axiom IPC không cho phép truyền raw pointer giữa process. Sai: ptr = 0x12345678 Đúng: SharedBuffer { region_id offset length } Mỗi process map region ở địa chỉ khác nhau vẫn hoạt động. | 0832 §604.33 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11824 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Shared memory ownership: Shared memory phải có ownership state: Created Published InUse Released Closed Không được tự động free khi một peer vẫn sở hữu reference hợp lệ. | 0832 §604.34 | GAP |

| RQ-C11-11826 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Handle: `Handle<T>` là opaque runtime token. Handle có: type index generation rights Không phải pointer. | 0832 §604.36 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11827 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Handle generation: Sau khi handle bị đóng: generation++ Handle cũ trở thành invalid. Điều này ngăn stale-handle reuse. | 0832 §604.37 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11828 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Capability transfer: Theo BOOTSTRAP-603, IPC có thể truyền capability. Ví dụ: Process A / / Capability<SharedRegion> ↓ Process B Transfer phải: - explicit; - authorized; - auditable; - có quyền attenuation. | 0832 §604.38 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11829 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Capability attenuation: Process gửi handle với quyền thấp hơn quyền gốc. Ví dụ: READ / WRITE có thể gửi: READ nhưng không thể tự nâng lên: READ / WRITE / EXECUTE | 0832 §604.39 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11830 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — OS handle transfer: Platform backend có thể truyền: - file descriptor; - Windows HANDLE; - Mach port; - platform-native IPC token. Application chỉ thấy: Handle<T> | 0832 §604.40 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11831 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Handle type safety: Handle phải mang type information compile-time: Handle<File> Handle<SharedRegion> Handle<Socket> Handle<Device> Không implicit cast giữa các handle type. | 0832 §604.41 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11832 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Transport abstraction: Transport interface: trait Transport { fn send(self, message: Message) -> Result fn receive(self) -> Result<Message> fn close(self) } Backend: Loopback Pipe UnixDomainSocket WindowsNamedPipe SharedMemory PlatformNative | 0832 §604.42 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11833 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Loopback transport: Dùng cho: - unit tests; - same-process modules; - benchmarks. Không syscall. | 0832 §604.43 | GAP |

| RQ-C11-11835 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Linux backend: Ưu tiên: Unix Domain Socket shared memory eventfd/futex tương ứng tùy transport. | 0832 §604.45 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11836 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — macOS backend: Có thể map xuống: Unix Domain Socket Mach-based native transport shared memory Core API không phụ thuộc Mach. | 0832 §604.46 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11837 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Android backend: Android adapter có thể tích hợp: Binder Unix Domain Socket shared memory primitives Binder-specific semantics nằm trong platform layer. | 0832 §604.47 | GAP |

| RQ-C11-11839 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — WASM: WASM sandbox không có native process IPC mặc định. Core phải cung cấp capability-dependent adapter: HostMessage HostSharedBuffer Nếu host không cung cấp IPC: IPC capability unavailable Không giả lập bằng hidden global state. | 0832 §604.49 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11840 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Service discovery: Service discovery gồm: register lookup resolve watch unregister Không bắt buộc broker trung tâm. | 0832 §604.50 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11841 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Brokerless default: Core IPC mặc định: Client ───────── Server Không: Client → Broker → Server trừ khi platform yêu cầu. Điều này giảm: - latency; - memory; - failure points; - attack surface. | 0832 §604.51 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11842 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Optional broker: Một broker có thể được xây ở higher-level runtime cho: - dynamic discovery; - multi-tenant routing; - policy management; - service lifecycle. Broker không thuộc IPC primitive core. | 0832 §604.52 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11843 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Service registration: Service đăng ký: ServiceId Endpoint Version Capabilities Health Registration có lease hoặc explicit lifetime. | 0832 §604.53 | GAP |

| RQ-C11-11845 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Peer authentication: Local IPC có thể dựa trên OS credentials. Application-level authentication là optional. Core không tự invent cryptography. | RQ-C11-11846 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Authorization: Kết nối thành công không đồng nghĩa được phép gọi mọi method. Authorization chain: OS identity ↓ Capability ↓ Endpoint policy ↓ Method permission ↓ Operation phù hợp BOOTSTRAP-603. | 0832 §604.56 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11847 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Method capability: Có thể yêu cầu: @requires(ipc.call("ImageProcessor.resize")) fn use_processor(...) Compiler/runtime kiểm tra capability metadata. | 0832 §604.57 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11848 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Connection handshake: Handshake tối thiểu: protocol_version endpoint_id peer_id feature_flags schema_versions transport_features security_context Handshake phải bounded. | 0832 §604.58 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11849 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Feature negotiation: Ví dụ: ZERO_COPY SHARED_MEMORY HANDLE_TRANSFER STREAMING COMPRESSION CANCELLATION Hai peer chỉ sử dụng feature chung. | 0832 §604.59 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11850 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Version negotiation: Nếu protocol version không tương thích: ProtocolMismatch Không cố decode message bằng format không tương thích. | 0832 §604.60 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11851 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Ordering: Trong cùng một ordered channel: M1 → M2 → M3 receiver thấy: M1 → M2 → M3 Cross-channel ordering không được đảm bảo. | 0832 §604.61 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11852 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Delivery semantics: Core cung cấp: SendAccepted DeliveredToTransport Received Completed Các trạng thái khác nhau phải được phân biệt. `send()` không mặc định có nghĩa remote application đã xử lý message. | 0832 §604.62 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11853 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — At-most-once RPC: RPC mặc định có semantics: at-most-once per request identity Runtime có thể detect duplicate request ID trong retry window. Không tuyên bố exactly-once execution. | 0832 §604.63 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11854 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Retry: Retry chỉ được tự động nếu operation được đánh dấu idempotent: @idempotent fn get(...) Operation mutation không được retry tự động mặc định. | 0832 §604.64 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11855 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Timeout: API hỗ trợ: request.with_timeout(500ms) Timeout phải được truyền thành deadline. | 0832 §604.65 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11856 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Deadline: Deadline format: MonotonicTimestamp Không dùng wall-clock để timeout. | 0832 §604.66 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11857 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Cancellation: Request có cancellation token: cancel(request) Cancellation là cooperative. Server có thể nhận: CancellationRequested Không guarantee process/thread bị terminate ngay lập tức. | 0832 §604.67 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11858 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Disconnect: Peer disconnect tạo event: PeerDisconnected Pending requests chuyển thành: PeerUnavailable hoặc status cụ thể. | 0832 §604.68 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11859 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Crash detection: Nếu process chết, OS transport phải phát hiện disconnect. Runtime không được chờ vô hạn. | 0832 §604.69 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11860 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Reconnect: Client có thể: reconnect() nhưng pending request không tự động được replay trừ khi semantics cho phép. | 0832 §604.70 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11861 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Service restart: Service restart tạo: new InstanceId new Generation Client không được coi endpoint cũ là cùng process. | 0832 §604.71 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11862 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Backpressure: IPC phải có backpressure. Không cho phép producer tạo queue vô hạn. Các chiến lược: Block Fail Drop Coalesce AwaitCapacity | 0832 §604.72 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11863 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Event backpressure: Event subscriber chậm có thể: DropOldest DropNewest BlockProducer DisconnectSlowPeer Policy phải explicit. | 0832 §604.73 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11864 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Queue: Queue có: max_messages max_bytes current_messages current_bytes Counters phải atomic/lock-free hoặc low-contention tùy backend. | 0832 §604.74 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11865 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Flow control: Streaming sử dụng credit/window: sender → N bytes receiver → credit sender → next bytes Tránh memory explosion. | 0832 §604.75 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11866 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Shared-memory ring buffer: IPC cung cấp optional ring buffer: producer ↓ [slot][slot][slot][slot] ↓ consumer Mỗi slot có: state sequence length payload | 0832 §604.76 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11867 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Ring-buffer states: Ví dụ: FREE RESERVED READY READING FREE State transitions phải atomic. | 0832 §604.77 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11868 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Memory ordering: Shared-memory synchronization phải chỉ rõ memory ordering. Không phụ thuộc compiler accidental behavior. Axiom atomic model phải map xuống: Acquire Release AcqRel SeqCst Relaxed theo core concurrency specification. | 0832 §604.78 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11869 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Cache-line considerations: Shared-memory structures nên hỗ trợ alignment metadata để tránh false sharing. Compiler có thể cung cấp: @cache_aligned cho IPC hot structures. | 0832 §604.79 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11870 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Shared-memory ABI descriptor: Region có header: magic version schema_id architecture pointer_size alignment endianness capacity flags Không chứa process-local pointer. | 0832 §604.80 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11871 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Shared-memory corruption: Nếu header/schema invalid: RegionCorrupt Consumer không được dereference dữ liệu. | 0832 §604.81 | GAP |

| RQ-C11-11873 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Executable shared memory: IPC runtime không được mặc định hỗ trợ executable shared memory. Chỉ được bật với capability: memory.exec và policy phù hợp. | 0832 §604.83 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11874 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Large buffer lifecycle: API: region = SharedRegion.create(size) buffer = region.slice(offset, length) send(buffer) Receiver: buffer = message.shared_buffer() Release: buffer.release() | 0832 §604.84 | GAP |

| RQ-C11-11877 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Borrow semantics IPC: Không sử dụng borrow checker global. IPC borrow chỉ là runtime contract: borrow valid until message completion Compiler có thể enforce một số lifetime đơn giản. | 0832 §604.87 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11878 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Message builder: Compiler/runtime cung cấp: MessageBuilder cho dynamic message construction. Static generated messages vẫn là fast path. | 0832 §604.88 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11879 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Generated codec: Từ: struct User { id: u64 name: string } compiler tạo: encode_User() decode_User() Không cần reflection runtime. | 0832 §604.89 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11880 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Compile-time serialization: Compiler biết: field offsets field types schema IDs bounds và có thể inline codec. | 0832 §604.90 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11881 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Decode safety: Generated decoder phải: 1. kiểm tra header; 2. kiểm tra payload length; 3. kiểm tra field count; 4. kiểm tra integer overflow; 5. kiểm tra allocation limit; 6. decode; 7. validate semantic constraints. | 0832 §604.91 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11882 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Semantic validation: Schema có thể khai báo: age: u8 @range(0..150) Decoder có thể reject: InvalidValue | 0832 §604.92 | GAP |

| RQ-C11-11884 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Compression: Compression không thuộc fast-path mặc định. Có thể bật: COMPRESSED khi payload đủ lớn. Compression phải chịu giới hạn resource. | 0832 §604.94 | GAP |

| RQ-C11-11886 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Encryption: Encryption là optional transport feature. Không ép mọi local IPC phải encryption nếu OS đã cung cấp security boundary phù hợp. Nếu policy yêu cầu confidentiality, transport phải fail closed khi encryption unavailable. | 0832 §604.96 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11887 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Integrity: Message có thể có integrity metadata: auth tag / signature nếu security policy yêu cầu. | 0832 §604.97 | GAP |

| RQ-C11-11889 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — IPC quotas: Mỗi peer có thể bị giới hạn: max_connections max_inflight max_queue_bytes max_shared_memory max_message_size max_handles | 0832 §604.99 | GAP |

| RQ-C11-11891 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Threading model: IPC runtime không được tạo một OS thread cho mỗi connection theo mặc định. Ưu tiên: event loop IO completion polling shared worker pool tùy platform. | 0832 §604.101 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11892 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Callback execution: Không chạy user callback trực tiếp trong privileged transport thread nếu có thể tránh. Transport thread chỉ: receive validate enqueue Application executor xử lý callback. | 0832 §604.102 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11893 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Async API: API: async fn call(...) phải tích hợp với Axiom async runtime. Không tạo event-loop riêng cho mỗi IPC connection. | 0832 §604.103 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11894 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Sync API: Cho application đơn giản: response = client.call(request) Sync API chỉ là facade trên transport primitive. | 0832 §604.104 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11895 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Reentrancy: IPC callback không được mặc định re-enter cùng state machine theo cách gây deadlock. Runtime phải document rõ: callback context lock context executor context | 0832 §604.105 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11896 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Deadlock avoidance: IPC runtime không giữ global IPC lock khi: calling user code waiting remote response performing arbitrary allocation | 0832 §604.106 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11897 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Local call optimization: Nếu compiler chứng minh client/server cùng process: RPC → direct function call có thể được tối ưu. Semantics observable phải tương thích. | 0832 §604.107 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11898 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — In-process transport: `LoopbackTransport` dùng cùng message abstraction. Cho phép test: Client ↓ Loopback ↓ Server mà không cần process creation. | 0832 §604.108 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11899 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — IPC transaction context: Mỗi request có context: request_id peer_id deadline trace_id security_context Context tích hợp BOOTSTRAP-602. | 0832 §604.109 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11900 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Distributed tracing: IPC request có thể propagate: TraceId SpanId TraceFlags Không bắt buộc tracing để IPC hoạt động. | 0832 §604.110 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11901 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Logging: IPC events có structured event IDs: IPC_CONNECT IPC_DISCONNECT IPC_SEND IPC_RECEIVE IPC_TIMEOUT IPC_PROTOCOL_ERROR IPC_AUTH_FAILURE IPC_BACKPRESSURE Không log payload mặc định. | 0832 §604.111 | GAP |
| RQ-C11-11902 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Secret protection: Payload có field `Secret<T>` phải được: - redact trong logs; - không dump vào diagnostics; - không copy sang debug buffer. | 0832 §604.112 | GAP |

| RQ-C11-11904 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — IPC metrics: Metrics: messages_sent messages_received bytes_sent bytes_received active_connections pending_requests timeouts disconnects protocol_errors auth_failures queue_drops shared_memory_bytes Counters có thể disabled compile-time. | 0832 §604.114 | GAP |

Có configuration integration. 37. Có security-policy integration. 38. Có deterministic schema artifacts. 39. Có compiler IR representation. 40. Có dead-stripping/module separation. 41. | RQ-C11-12094 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Design conclusion: BOOTSTRAP-604 biến IPC thành một **typed, capability-aware, schema-versioned, zero-copy-capable native subsystem** thay vì chỉ là wrapper quanh socket/pipe. Đường đi tối ưu của Axiom là: typed API ↓ compile-time schema ↓ generated codec ↓ inline/small-message fast path ↓ native transport và đối với dữ liệu lớn: typed buffer ↓ SharedRegion ↓ capability transfer ↓ zero-copy access Điểm quan trọng là toàn bộ mô hình vẫn giữ nguyên triết lý của Axiom: explicit ownership explicit capability explicit lifetime bounded resources compile-time metadata native performance no mandatory GC no raw cross-process pointers | 0832 §604.304 | GAP |

| RQ-C11-12096 | ecosystem | post-v1 | — Mục tiêu: Axiom cần một runtime có khả năng quản lý vòng đời của: Process Service Worker Child Process Plugin Process Application Hệ thống phải xử lý: - start; - stop; - restart; - crash; - timeout; - dependency; - health; - watchdog; - resource limit; - graceful shutdown; - recovery; - service activation; - service isolation. Runtime phải **không biến thành một operating system thu nhỏ**. OS vẫn chịu trách nhiệm về process primitive. Axiom chịu trách nhiệm về: policy lifecycle dependency supervision health recovery | 0833 §605.0 | GAP |
